En %@ tu privacidad es lo primero. La ap: At %@ your privacy comes first. The app has no accounts or database and collects no personal data. Payments for %@ are processed by Stripe, not by us. This policy explains what information the app uses, where it is stored and who it communicates with.

Los pagos de la web (la suscripción trim:
Web payments (the quarterly subscription, its free trial and the one-time payment plan) are made by card and processed entirely by Stripe (stripe.com) on its own secure payment page (Stripe Checkout). You enter your card details directly into Stripe: they never go through the app or the developer. Stripe handles payment and billing data according to its own privacy policy (stripe.com/privacy).
When you pay, Stripe asks for an email address, to which it sends the receipt with its number. To unlock %@ in this browser, or recover it in another one, the app's intermediary asks Stripe whether that email and receipt number match a valid purchase; the app only receives which plan it is, when it started and when it renews or expires. The intermediary does not store your email or your receipt number. The developer can see purchases in the Stripe dashboard (payment email, amount, date and card country) to manage charges, refunds and support, but never your full card number.
Para mostrarte datos actualizados, la ap:
To show you up-to-date data, the app connects over HTTPS to these services:
• SFL Farmhand intermediary (Cloudflare Workers, workers.dev): farm and marketplace requests go through this service of the app, which adds the access key and forwards them to api.sunflower-land.com. It only receives the Farm ID looked up and does not store your Farm ID, your IP or your farm data (only a temporary in-memory copy of a few minutes to avoid repeating requests). To avoid querying the game once per user, it keeps for a while public game data that is the same for everyone: leaderboards, raffles and their winners, marketplace activity and farm names. The app also sends a random installation identifier used only for the request limit; it doesn't identify you and isn't stored.
• api.sunflower-land.com: faction pet data and, through the intermediary, farm and marketplace data.
• sfl.world: community prices and yield data (usually through the intermediary, which keeps a temporary copy; directly if it doesn't respond).
• api.coingecko.com: FLOWER token price (likewise: through the intermediary or directly).
• sunflower-land.com, animations.sunflower-land.com, pets.sunflower-land.com, buds.sunflower-land.com and raw.githubusercontent.com: game images.
• Stripe (checkout.stripe.com and billing.stripe.com): card payments, receipts and subscription management. The app's intermediary also checks your purchases with Stripe.
As with any internet connection, these services receive your IP address and the request made (for example, the Farm ID looked up). Each service handles that information according to its own privacy policy. Cloudflare, as the intermediary's provider, processes technical connection data under its own policy; the developer does not store that information.
La información permanece en tu dispositi: Information stays on your device until you delete it. You can delete it at any time from Settings → Legal & privacy → "Erase all app data", or by uninstalling the app. Erasing the data does not cancel a subscription or remove your purchases: they remain recorded at Stripe and you can recover them with "I already have Pro: restore", the email you paid with and the receipt number.
Todas las conexiones usan HTTPS cifrado,: All connections use encrypted HTTPS, the access key for the Sunflower Land API is not inside the app (it is kept encrypted as a secret in the app's intermediary service) and purchases are checked directly with Stripe from the intermediary, with a secret key that is not inside the app either. Even so, no system is 100% foolproof.
La app no está dirigida a menores de 13: The app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect information from children. To pay by card you must be of legal age or have permission from your parent or guardian.
Como la app no recopila datos personales: Since the app collects no personal data, we have no information about you to access, correct or delete. Everything the app stores is on your device and you can delete it yourself. Data about your purchases (payment email, amount and receipts) is kept by Stripe: to access, correct or request deletion of it, write to us and we will handle it with Stripe. If you have any questions, write to us at %@.
